mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vso_purchase_agreement ( agreement_id, agreement_code, sale_model_code, version_no, title, intro, detail, agreement_status, effective_from, effective_to, create_time, create_by, modify_time, modify_by, row_version, row_valid ) VALUES ( #{agreementId}, #{agreementCode}, #{saleModelCode}, #{versionNo}, #{title}, #{intro}, #{detail}, #{agreementStatus}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, now(), #{createBy}, now(), #{modifyBy}, 1, 1 )
mapper.update:
UPDATE vso_purchase_agreement t SET
t.agreement_code = #{agreementCode},
t.sale_model_code = #{saleModelCode},
t.version_no = #{versionNo},
t.title = #{title},
t.intro = #{intro},
t.detail = #{detail},
t.agreement_status = #{agreementStatus},
t.effective_from = #{effectiveFrom},
t.effective_to = #{effectiveTo},
t.modify_by = #{modifyBy},
t.row_version = t.row_version + 1, t.modify_time = now() WHERE t.id = #{id}
UPDATE vso_purchase_agreement t SET t.row_version = t.row_version + 1, t.modify_time = now(), t.row_valid = 0 WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vso_purchase_agreement t WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.row_valid = 1
SELECT FROM vso_purchase_agreement t WHERE t.agreement_id = #{agreementId} AND t.row_valid = 1

SELECT FROM vso_purchase_agreement t WHERE t.row_valid = 1 AND t.agreement_status = 'active' AND (t.sale_model_code = #{saleModelCode} OR t.sale_model_code = 'GLOBAL') AND (t.effective_from IS NULL OR t.effective_from <= #{now}) AND (t.effective_to IS NULL OR t.effective_to > #{now}) ORDER BY t.agreement_code ASC, t.version_no DESC, CASE WHEN t.sale_model_code = #{saleModelCode} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC
